rescue_stage_pinning.rule: Each codeword's rescue evaluation (DEV and CONFIRMATION) runs as ONE SLURM job on --gpus=l40s:1 (the GPU class of every P6 Stage-0 readout and G2 job) and contains ALL of that codeword's rescue arms: liveness (BASE/KO/KO_SELF/KO_FULL), the candidate(s) and the full rank-matched control families.
rescue_stage_pinning.VOID: A codeword's rescue result is VOID if its arms come from more than one SLURM job or more than one GPU type (checked from every arm's RUNMETA slurm_job_id and gpu), or if any arm is not DONE. A VOID codeword stays in the denominator with reason 'VOID_RESCUE_PROVENANCE' and is excluded from H6a; it may be re-run ONCE in a fresh single job (the whole arm set), never patched arm-by-arm.
rescue_stage_pinning.requeue: rescue jobs use --no-requeue; a preempted job leaves a VOID codeword that is re-run whole.
rescue_stage_pinning.hardware_note: incumbent basket/button rescue VALIDATION reads ran on a5000 (S-048/S-072); they are contaminated DEV reference points only and never enter H6a, so the a5000-vs-L40S difference does not touch the confirmatory test; it is a declared caveat for any descriptive comparison with them (S-062 cross-hardware readout noise).

declared_shared_noise_dependencies.identical_random_controls: The 46-random rank-r control families (r in {1,4,16}; 138 bases) are BYTE-IDENTICAL across all 9 new codewords axis-fitted so far (lamp…wagon; same dcs_csi_axis seed 20260915 and rank list) and will be for every new codeword. The incumbents basket/button share only the 46 rank-1 random controls with the new codewords (the generator stream diverges after rank 1 because their rank list was {1,2,4,8,16,32}); basket and button share all 138 with each other. Shuffled-label controls are codeword-specific (fit on each codeword's own shuffled labels; 0/30 shared). => per-codeword specificity z's share control directions => correlated noise across codewords.
declared_shared_noise_dependencies.aligned_candidate_axes: Rank-1 candidate axes are moderately aligned across codewords: pairwise |cos| over 11 codewords min 0.328 / median 0.567 / max 0.745 (bucket·basket 0.745; lamp·basket 0.627). Codeword outcomes are therefore not independent draws.
declared_shared_noise_dependencies.shared_validation_domains: Every codeword's VALIDATION outcome (z) and held-out probe quality use the SAME 23 VALIDATION domains, the same demo pools and templates => shared domain-level noise across codewords (in addition to the within-codeword probe/outcome dependence declared in AMENDMENT_3 c).
declared_shared_noise_dependencies.consequence: H6a's permutation Spearman treats confirmation codewords as exchangeable independent units; these dependencies make that approximate. Declared, not removed; the H6a decision rule is unchanged. Any H6a result is reported with this caveat, and a pass is not described as a population law beyond the measured codewords.

operational_rules.commit_before_submit: No P6 job is submitted unless `git status --porcelain <every script it runs>` is empty (the script and every python it calls are committed); otherwise the submission waits for the parent's commit.
operational_rules.gpu_cap: submit only if `squeue -u $USER -h -p killable -t R | wc -l` < 6.
